title: Japanese Chicken Fritters
description: Crispy on the outside, juicy on the inside, these Japanese-style fritters are a delightful twist on traditional chicken fritters. Serve with your favorite dipping sauce.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, cornstarch, and a pinch of salt.
2. In a separate bowl, whisk together soy sauce, sugar, and eggs.
3. Add the grated daikon and carrot to the soy sauce mixture and mix well.
4. Add the chicken to the soy sauce mixture and mix until just combined.
5. Add the flour mixture to the chicken mixture and mix until just combined.
7. Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
8. Using a small ice cream scoop, drop the chicken mixture into the oil and flatten slightly.
9. Fry for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until golden brown and cooked through.
10. Drain on paper towels and serve hot.
